import json
import os
import html
import re
from google.colab import drive

# 1. 掛載 Google Drive
drive.mount('/content/drive')

# 2. 設定路徑 (支援帶或不帶 .json)
input_file = '/content/drive/MyDrive/Google AI Studio/系統傳承與戰情看板架構8_pro_3.1'
if not os.path.exists(input_file) and os.path.exists(input_file + '.json'):
    input_file = input_file + '.json'

output_file = '/content/drive/MyDrive/Google AI Studio/系統傳承與戰情看板架構8_pro_3.1.html'

def extract_images_from_chunk(chunk):
    """精準提取 Google AI Studio 的 driveImage 與 inlineImage"""
    img_html_list = []
    
    # 🌟 1. 命中真相一：Google Drive 雲端圖片 (driveImage -> id)
    if 'driveImage' in chunk:
        drive_info = chunk['driveImage']
        if isinstance(drive_info, dict) and 'id' in drive_info:
            drive_id = drive_info['id']
            # Google Drive 官方高清 CDN 直連網址
            thumb_url = f"https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id={drive_id}&sz=w1600"
            view_url = f"https://drive.google.com/file/d/{drive_id}/view"
            img_html_list.append(
                f'<div class="img-container">'
                f'<a href="{view_url}" target="_blank" title="點擊開啟 Google Drive 原圖">'
                f'<img src="{thumb_url}" class="chat-img" alt="Drive截圖: {drive_id}">'
                f'</a></div>'
            )

    # 🌟 2. 命中真相二：剪貼簿直接貼上的 Base64 圖片 (inlineImage -> data)
    if 'inlineImage' in chunk:
        inline_info = chunk['inlineImage']
        if isinstance(inline_info, dict):
            mime = inline_info.get('mimeType', 'image/png')
            b64_data = inline_info.get('data', '')
            if b64_data:
                img_src = f"data:{mime};base64,{b64_data}"
                img_html_list.append(
                    f'<div class="img-container">'
                    f'<a href="{img_src}" target="_blank" title="點擊開啟原圖">'
                    f'<img src="{img_src}" class="chat-img" alt="內嵌截圖">'
                    f'</a></div>'
                )

    return "".join(img_html_list)

def markdown_to_html(text):
    """進階 Markdown 轉換 (支援代碼塊、粗體與 Markdown 圖片語法)"""
    if not text: return ""

    # 1. 先暫存代碼塊避免被轉義
    code_blocks = []
    def save_code(match):
        code_blocks.append(match.group(0))
        return f"__CODE_BLOCK_{len(code_blocks)-1}__"
    text = re.sub(r'
(.*?)\n(.*?)
', save_code, text, flags=re.DOTALL)

    # 2. 轉義基本 HTML 特殊符號
    text = html.escape(text)

    # 3. 處理 Markdown 圖片: ![alt](url) -> 轉為真實 <img>
    img_pattern = r'!\[(.*?)\]\((.*?)\)'
    text = re.sub(img_pattern, r'<div class="img-container"><a href="\2" target="_blank"><img src="\2" alt="\1" class="chat-img"></a></div>', text)

    # 4. 處理 Markdown 超連結: [text](url)
    link_pattern = r'\[(.*?)\]\((.*?)\)'
    text = re.sub(link_pattern, r'<a href="\2" target="_blank" class="chat-link">\1</a>', text)

    # 5. 處理粗體 **text**
    text = re.sub(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', r'<strong>\1</strong>', text)

    # 6. 還原代碼塊並高亮包裝
    for idx, cb in enumerate(code_blocks):
        m = re.match(r'
(.*?)\n(.*?)
', cb, flags=re.DOTALL)
        if m:
            lang = m.group(1).strip() if m.group(1) else "code"
            code_content = html.escape(m.group(2))
            replacement = f'<div class="code-container"><div class="code-header">{lang}</div><pre><code>{code_content}</code></pre></div>'
            text = text.replace(f"__CODE_BLOCK_{idx}__", replacement)

    return text

def process_gemini_json():
    if not os.path.exists(input_file):
        print(f"❌ 錯誤：找不到輸入檔案：{input_file}")
        return

    print(f"🔄 正在讀取：{input_file}")

    try:
        with open(input_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 讀取失敗：{e}")
        return

    # 取得 chunks 列表
    chunks = data.get('chunkedPrompt', {}).get('chunks', [])
    if not chunks and 'chunks' in data:
        chunks = data.get('chunks', [])
    if not chunks and 'messages' in data:
        chunks = data.get('messages', [])

    html_template = """<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

        .user-row .role-badge { color: #0d6efd; align-self: flex-end; }
        .model-row .role-badge { color: #198754; align-self: flex-start; }

        .user-bubble { background-color: var(--user-bg); align-self: flex-end; border-bottom-right-radius: 4px; }
        .model-bubble { background-color: var(--model-bg); align-self: flex-start; border-bottom-left-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #e3e3e3; }
        .thought-container { background-color: var(--thought-bg); border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px; margin-bottom: 15px; border-left: 4px solid #fadb14; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #856404; align-self: flex-start; max-width: 90%; }

        .code-header { background: #333; color: #aaa; padding: 5px 15px; font-size: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #444; }
        pre { margin: 0; padding: 15px; overflow-x: auto; }

        .time { font-size: 0.7rem; color: #9ca3af; margin-top: 8px; }
        .user-row .time { text-align: right; }
        
        /* 🌟 高質感截圖樣式 */
        .img-container { margin: 8px 0; }
        .chat-img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 480px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; }
        .chat-img:hover { transform: scale(1.015); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
        .chat-link { color: #1a73e8; text-decoration: none; }
        .chat-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    </style>
    <title>Gemini 紀錄檢視器</title>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="header"><h1>Cloud AI Studio 歷史紀錄</h1></div>
    <div class="container">
"""

    content_html = ""
    total_imgs = 0

    for chunk in chunks:
        role = chunk.get('role', 'user')
        text = chunk.get('text', '')
        is_thought = chunk.get('isThought', False)
        create_time = chunk.get('createTime', '').split('.')[0].replace('T', ' ')

        # 🌟 提取圖片 HTML (driveImage / inlineImage)
        imgs_html = extract_images_from_chunk(chunk)
        if imgs_html:
            total_imgs += 1

        body_html = markdown_to_html(text) + imgs_html

        # 若完全沒有文字也沒有圖片，則跳過空節點
        if not body_html.strip():
            continue

        if role == "user":
            content_html += f"""

aspx
<%@ Page Language="C#" AutoEventWireup="true" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Data" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Data.SqlClient" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Web.Script.Serialization" %>
<%@ Import Namespace="System.Collections.Generic" %>

<script runat="server">
protected void Page_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
{
    Response.ContentType = "application/json";
    Response.Charset = "utf-8";

    // 跨域放行
    Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
    Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "POST, GET, OPTIONS");
    Response.AddHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type");
    if (Request.HttpMethod == "OPTIONS") { Response.End(); return; }

    string kw = Request.QueryString["kw"];
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(kw))
    {
        Response.Write("[]");
        return;
    }

    kw = kw.Trim();
    string connStr = "Data Source=localhost;Initial Catalog=stockchange;Integrated Security=True;";
    List<Dictionary<string, object>> list = new List<Dictionary<string, object>>();

    try
    {
        using (SqlConnection conn = new SqlConnection(connStr))
        {
            conn.Open();

            // 🌟 智慧判斷：若搜尋詞完全命中主題，開啟「全量無截斷模式 (TOP 2000)」
            string sql;
            bool isExactSession = false;

            // 先檢查是否是精確查詢某個聊天室
            using (SqlCommand checkCmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.AI_Studio_ChatLogs WHERE SessionTitle = @t", conn))
            {
                checkCmd.Parameters.Add("@t", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = kw;
                int count = (int)checkCmd.ExecuteScalar();
                if (count > 0) isExactSession = true;
            }

            if (isExactSession)
            {
                // 模式 A：主題完整回放 (取消 100 筆限制，上限放寬到 2000，按 MsgIndex 順序排列)
                sql = @"
                    SELECT TOP 2000 
                        SessionTitle, MsgIndex, Role, MsgTime, 
                        MentionedPrograms, ImageUrls, MsgContent,
                        CONVERT(varchar, FileModifyTime, 120) AS FileModifyTime
                    FROM dbo.AI_Studio_ChatLogs
                    WHERE SessionTitle = @kw
                    ORDER BY MsgIndex ASC";
            }
            else
            {
                // 模式 B：一般關鍵字全文檢索 (TOP 200)
                sql = @"
                    SELECT TOP 200 
                        SessionTitle, MsgIndex, Role, MsgTime, 
                        MentionedPrograms, ImageUrls, MsgContent,
                        CONVERT(varchar, FileModifyTime, 120) AS FileModifyTime
                    FROM dbo.AI_Studio_ChatLogs
                    WHERE MentionedPrograms LIKE @kwLike 
                       OR MsgContent LIKE @kwLike 
                       OR SessionTitle LIKE @kwLike
                    ORDER BY FileModifyTime DESC, MsgIndex ASC";
            }

            using (SqlCommand cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
            {
                if (isExactSession)
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.Add("@kw", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = kw;
                }
                else
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.Add("@kwLike", SqlDbType.NVarChar).Value = "%" + kw + "%";
                }

                using (SqlDataReader dr = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                {
                    while (dr.Read())
                    {
                        var row = new Dictionary<string, object>();
                        row["SessionTitle"] = dr["SessionTitle"].ToString();
                        row["MsgIndex"] = dr["MsgIndex"];
                        row["Role"] = dr["Role"].ToString();
                        row["MsgTime"] = dr["MsgTime"] != DBNull.Value ? dr["MsgTime"].ToString() : "";
                        row["MentionedPrograms"] = dr["MentionedPrograms"] != DBNull.Value ? dr["MentionedPrograms"].ToString() : "";
                        row["ImageUrls"] = dr["ImageUrls"] != DBNull.Value ? dr["ImageUrls"].ToString() : "";
                        row["MsgContent"] = dr["MsgContent"] != DBNull.Value ? dr["MsgContent"].ToString() : "";
                        row["FileModifyTime"] = dr["FileModifyTime"] != DBNull.Value ? dr["FileModifyTime"].ToString() : "";
                        list.Add(row);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        Response.Write("[]");
        return;
    }

    JavaScriptSerializer js = new JavaScriptSerializer();
    js.MaxJsonLength = int.MaxValue;
    Response.Write(js.Serialize(list));
}
</script>

USE [master];
GO
-- 1. 拔除 IIS 帳號的 sysadmin 最高管理員權限

USE [stockchange];
GO
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.database_principals WHERE name = 'NT AUTHORITY\IUSR')
    CREATE USER [NT AUTHORITY\IUSR] FOR LOGIN [NT AUTHORITY\IUSR];

ALTER ROLE [db_datareader] ADD MEMBER [NT AUTHORITY\IUSR]; -- 🌟 永久唯讀！
DENY INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, ALTER, DROP TO [NT AUTHORITY\IUSR]; -- 🌟 鐵血封殺任何寫入與破壞！
GO

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
===============================================================================
特工代號：quant_master_resonance_radar.py (163 條全宇宙量化自動共振雷達)
系統時空：2026 年 11 月 10 日
作戰目標：
  1. 遍歷 [stockchangedate].[dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] 全量 163 條策略範本
  2. 自動剔除非選股報表、自動容錯跳過失效語法
  3. 實裝【黃金 Top 30 法則】+ 梯隊名次加權 (前5名 1.5分, 6~15名 1.2分, 16~30名 1.0分)
  4. 雙軌血統自然分離 (經典傳承 ID < 258 ✕ DeepSeek 現代核武 ID >= 258)
  5. 自動入庫 [stockchange].[dbo].[Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard]
  6. 產出極美觀前端戰情報告 quant_resonance_board.html
===============================================================================
"""

import os
import re
import time
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pyodbc

DB_CONFIG = {
    'server': r'localhost',
    'database': 'stockchangedate',
    'driver': '{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}',
    'trusted_connection': 'yes'
}

OUTPUT_HTML = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\quant_resonance_board.html"

def get_connection(db_name="stockchangedate"):
    conn_str = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={db_name};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};"
    conn = pyodbc.connect(conn_str)
    return conn

def clean_code(val):
    if pd.isna(val) or val is None:
        return ""
    s = str(val).strip()
    if s.endswith(".0"):
        s = s[:-2]
    return s

def prepare_sql(raw_sql):
    """防禦型 SQL 語法前處理：補齊 SELECT、識別指定庫"""
    target_db = "stockchangedate"
    m = re.search(r'/\*資料庫:(\w+)\*/', raw_sql)
    if m:
        target_db = m.group(1)
    
    # 清理多行註解
    sql_clean = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', raw_sql, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    
    # 若以 TOP 開頭，自動補上 SELECT
    if sql_clean.upper().startswith("TOP "):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
    elif not sql_clean.upper().startswith("SELECT") and not sql_clean.upper().startswith("WITH"):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
        
    return target_db, sql_clean

def init_destination_table(conn_dest):
    """確保目標排行榜資料表存在"""
    cursor = conn_dest.cursor()
    cursor.execute("""
        IF OBJECT_ID('stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard', 'U') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            CREATE TABLE stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard (
                [ID]               INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
                [TradeDate]        INT NOT NULL,
                [Rank]             INT NOT NULL,
                [StockCode]        NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
                [StockName]        NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TotalScore]       DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
                [TotalHits]        INT NOT NULL,
                [LegacyHits]       INT NOT NULL,
                [DeepSeekHits]     INT NOT NULL,
                [ResonanceTag]     NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TriggeredTactics] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
                [CurrentPrice]     DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [ChangePercent]    DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [Volume]           INT NULL,
                [Industry]         NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [UpdateTime]       DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
            );
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Resonance_Date_Rank] 
            ON stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard ([TradeDate], [Rank]);
        END
    """)
    conn_dest.commit()
    cursor.close()

def main():
    start_time = time.time()
    print("================================================================================")
    print("🚀【163 條全宇宙量化自動共振雷達啟動】")
    print("🎯 作戰模式：0 人工標註 ✕ 全量策略自動投票 ✕ 雙軌跨世代會師")
    print("================================================================================")

    # 1. 建立目標資料庫連線
    conn_dest = get_connection("stockchange")
    init_destination_table(conn_dest)

    # 2. 自動探測最新交易日期
    cursor_dest = conn_dest.cursor()
    cursor_dest.execute("SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT)) FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo WHERE TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT) IS NOT NULL")
    row_date = cursor_dest.fetchone()
    latest_date = row_date[0] if (row_date and row_date[0]) else int(datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))
    print(f"📅 鎖定最新市場交易日基準：【{latest_date}】\n")

    # 3. 讀取所有 163 條量化範本
    conn_src = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    templates_df = pd.read_sql("""
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL 
        FROM dbo.QuantSqlTemplates 
        WHERE CorrectSQL IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CorrectSQL)) <> ''
        ORDER BY TemplateID ASC
    """, conn_src)
    total_templates = len(templates_df)
    print(f"📦 成功加載 {total_templates} 條策略範本，開始平行巡航掃描...\n")

    # 4. 投票統計容器
    # stock_code -> {name, total_score, total_hits, legacy_hits, deepseek_hits, tactics_list}
    voting_pool = {}

    success_strategies = 0
    skipped_non_strategy = 0
    error_strategies = 0

    conn_exec = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    cursor_exec = conn_exec.cursor()
    cursor_exec.timeout = 4  # 4 秒逾時保護防卡死

    for idx, row in templates_df.iterrows():
        t_id = row['TemplateID']
        t_title = row['Title'] if row['Title'] else f"範本 #{t_id}"
        t_sql = row['CorrectSQL']

        target_db, prepared_sql = prepare_sql(t_sql)
        is_deepseek = (t_id >= 258)
        tag_type = "現代核武" if is_deepseek else "經典傳承"

        try:
            # 執行單一範本查詢
            df_res = pd.read_sql(prepared_sql, conn_exec)

            if df_res.empty:
                continue

            # 🌟【特徵過濾 1】：檢查是否存在股票代號欄位
            code_col = None
            for cand in ['代號', '股票代號', 'code', 'mail1', 'StockCode', '證券代號']:
                if cand in df_res.columns:
                    code_col = cand
                    break

            if not code_col:
                # 無代碼，視為大盤/巨集/統計報表，自動排除！
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            name_col = None
            for cand in ['名稱', '股票名稱', 'name', 'word1', 'StockName', '證券名稱']:
                if cand in df_res.columns:
                    name_col = cand
                    break

            # 🌟【特徵過濾 2】：若回傳超過 500 筆且無特定篩選，視為全市場 dump，跳過
            if len(df_res) > 500 and 'ORDER BY' not in prepared_sql.upper():
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            # 清洗代碼
            df_res[code_col] = df_res[code_col].apply(clean_code)
            df_res = df_res[df_res[code_col] != ''].copy()

            if df_res.empty:
                continue

            # 🌟【黃金 Top 30 法則】：強制只取前 30 名精英！
            df_top = df_res.head(30)
            hit_count_this = len(df_top)

            for rank_idx, (_, r_stock) in enumerate(df_top.iterrows()):
                code = r_stock[code_col]
                name = str(r_stock[name_col]).strip() if name_col and pd.notna(r_stock[name_col]) else ""

                # 梯隊加權計分制
                if rank_idx < 5:
                    pts = 1.5
                elif rank_idx < 15:
                    pts = 1.2
                else:
                    pts = 1.0

                if code not in voting_pool:
                    voting_pool[code] = {
                        'name': name,
                        'total_score': 0.0,
                        'total_hits': 0,
                        'legacy_hits': 0,
                        'deepseek_hits': 0,
                        'tactics': []
                    }

                if name and not voting_pool[code]['name']:
                    voting_pool[code]['name'] = name

                voting_pool[code]['total_score'] += pts
                voting_pool[code]['total_hits'] += 1

                if is_deepseek:
                    voting_pool[code]['deepseek_hits'] += 1
                else:
                    voting_pool[code]['legacy_hits'] += 1

                tactic_label = f"[{tag_type}] {t_title}"
                if tactic_label not in voting_pool[code]['tactics']:
                    voting_pool[code]['tactics'].append(tactic_label)

            success_strategies += 1

        except Exception as e:
            error_strategies += 1
            # 容錯：記錄並安靜跳過，絕不中斷作戰
            continue

    conn_exec.close()
    conn_src.close()

    print(f"📊 巡航完成：成功開火 {success_strategies} 條選股策略 | 自動排除非個股/全市場報表 {skipped_non_strategy} 條 | 容錯語法 {error_strategies} 條")
    print(f"🎯 共計有 {len(voting_pool)} 檔個股獲得策略投票支持！\n")

    if not voting_pool:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合任何策略之共振標的。")
        return

    # 5. 抓取最新個股行情 (現價, 漲幅%, 總量, 產業) 進行全知合體
    all_codes = list(voting_pool.keys())
    codes_str = "', '".join(all_codes)
    info_df = pd.read_sql(f"""
        SELECT 
            LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) AS 代號,
            名稱,
            TRY_CAST(成交價 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 現價,
            TRY_CAST(漲幅 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 今日漲幅,
            TRY_CAST(總量 AS INT) AS 總量,
            產業分類
        FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) IN ('{codes_str}')
    """, conn_dest)

    info_map = {row['代號']: row for _, row in info_df.iterrows()}

    # 6. 組裝排行榜列表
    leaderboard_records = []
    for code, data in voting_pool.items():
        stk_info = info_map.get(code, {})
        final_name = stk_info.get('名稱') if pd.notna(stk_info.get('名稱')) else data['name']
        price = stk_info.get('現價', 0.0)
        pct = stk_info.get('今日漲幅', 0.0)
        vol = stk_info.get('總量', 0)
        industry = stk_info.get('產業分類', '')

        # 判定共振標籤
        if data['legacy_hits'] >= 2 and data['deepseek_hits'] >= 2:
            resonance_tag = "🌟 跨世代天王共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 5:
            resonance_tag = "🔥 多重超強共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 3:
            resonance_tag = "⚡ 三重共振伏兵"
        else:
            resonance_tag = "雙重共振" if data['total_hits'] == 2 else "單策略命中"

        tactics_summary = "; ".join(data['tactics'])

        leaderboard_records.append({
            'code': code,
            'name': final_name,
            'total_score': round(data['total_score'], 2),
            'total_hits': data['total_hits'],
            'legacy_hits': data['legacy_hits'],
            'deepseek_hits': data['deepseek_hits'],
            'resonance_tag': resonance_tag,
            'tactics_summary': tactics_summary,
            'price': price if pd.notna(price) else 0.0,
            'change_pct': pct if pd.notna(pct) else 0.0,
            'volume': int(vol) if pd.notna(vol) else 0,
            'industry': industry if pd.notna(industry) else ""
        })

    # 按總得分降序、總命中數降序排列
    leaderboard_records.sort(key=lambda x: (x['total_score'], x['total_hits']), reverse=True)

    # 7. 寫入資料庫 stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard
    cursor_dest.execute("DELETE FROM stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard WHERE TradeDate = ?", (latest_date,))
    
    insert_sql = """
        INSERT INTO stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard
        ([TradeDate], [Rank], [StockCode], [StockName], [TotalScore], [TotalHits], [LegacyHits], [DeepSeekHits], [ResonanceTag], [TriggeredTactics], [CurrentPrice], [ChangePercent], [Volume], [Industry])
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """
    db_rows = []
    for rank, item in enumerate(leaderboard_records[:100], 1):  # 儲存前 100 名
        db_rows.append((
            latest_date,
            rank,
            item['code'],
            item['name'],
            item['total_score'],
            item['total_hits'],
            item['legacy_hits'],
            item['deepseek_hits'],
            item['resonance_tag'],
            item['tactics_summary'],
            item['price'],
            item['change_pct'],
            item['volume'],
            item['industry']
        ))

    cursor_dest.fast_executemany = False
    cursor_dest.executemany(insert_sql, db_rows)
    conn_dest.commit()
    cursor_dest.close()
    conn_dest.close()

    elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 2)

    # 8. 終端王者戰報輸出
    print(f"🏆【163 條全策略自動投票結果 TOP 10】 (耗時 {elapsed} 秒)")
    print(f"{'排名':<4} {'代號':<6} {'名稱':<8} {'總分':>6} {'總票':>4} {'傳承':>4} {'現代':>4} {'現價':>7} {'漲幅%':>7} {'共振標籤':<16} {'命中核心戰術摘要'}")
    print("-" * 115)
    for rank, item in enumerate(leaderboard_records[:10], 1):
        pct_str = f"{item['change_pct']:+.2f}%"
        print(f"#{rank:<3} {item['code']:<6} {item['name']:<8} {item['total_score']:>6.1f} {item['total_hits']:>4} {item['legacy_hits']:>4} {item['deepseek_hits']:>4} {item['price']:>7.2f} {pct_str:>7} {item['resonance_tag']:<16} {item['tactics_summary'][:40]}...")

    # 9. 產生極致美觀的靜態大屏 (quant_resonance_board.html)
    generate_html_report(latest_date, leaderboard_records[:50], elapsed, success_strategies)
    print(f"\n🌐 前端戰情報告大屏已生成完畢：\n👉 {OUTPUT_HTML}")
    print("================================================================================")

def generate_html_report(date_int, records, elapsed, active_strats):
    """產出手機、電腦秒開的高質感暗黑系戰情報告"""
    rows_html = ""
    for rank, r in enumerate(records, 1):
        tag_badge = ""
        if "跨世代" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-warning text-dark"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown me-1"></i>跨世代天王共振</span>'
        elif "多重" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-danger"><i class="fa-solid fa-fire me-1"></i>多重超強共振</span>'
        elif "三重" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-primary"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt me-1"></i>三重共振伏兵</span>'
        else:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-secondary">一般共振</span>'

        pct_color = "text-danger" if r['change_pct'] > 0 else ("text-success" if r['change_pct'] < 0 else "text-muted")
        pct_str = f"{r['change_pct']:+.2f}%"

        tactics_pills = "".join([f'<span class="tactic-pill">{t.strip()}</span>' for t in r['tactics_summary'].split(';') if t.strip()])

        rows_html += f"""
        <tr>
            <td class="text-center fw-bold text-info">#{rank}</td>
            <td class="fw-bold fs-5 text-white">{r['code']}</td>
            <td class="fw-bold fs-5 text-warning">{r['name']}</td>
            <td>{tag_badge}</td>
            <td class="text-center fw-bold fs-5 text-info">{r['total_score']}</td>
            <td class="text-center"><span class="badge bg-dark border border-secondary">{r['total_hits']} 票</span></td>
            <td class="text-center text-secondary small">{r['legacy_hits']} / {r['deepseek_hits']}</td>
            <td class="text-end fw-bold fs-5 text-white">{r['price']:.2f}</td>
            <td class="text-end fw-bold fs-5 {pct_color}">{pct_str}</td>
            <td class="text-end text-secondary small">{r['volume']:,}</td>
            <td class="text-secondary small">{r['industry']}</td>
            <td><div class="tactics-cell">{tactics_pills}</div></td>
        </tr>
        """

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Zen AI 量化全宇宙共振熱度榜 - {date_int}</title>
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.0/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        body {{ background-color: #0b1120; color: #cbd5e1; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Microsoft JhengHei, sans-serif; }}
        .header-card {{ background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b, #0f172a); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #334155; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }}
        .table-dark {{ background-color: #1e293b; border-color: #334155; }}
        .tactic-pill {{ display: inline-block; background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; color: #38bdf8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; margin: 2px; }}
        .tactics-cell {{ max-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto; }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container-fluid py-4 px-4">
    <div class="header-card d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
        <div>
            <h2 class="fw-bold text-info mb-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-radar me-2"></i>Zen AI 量化全宇宙共振熱度榜</h2>
            <div class="text-secondary">
                交易基準日：<span class="text-warning fw-bold">{date_int}</span> | 
                全員出擊：<span class="text-success fw-bold">{active_strats}</span> 條有效策略 | 
                雙軌架構：經典傳承 (ID&lt;258) ✕ 現代核武 (ID&ge;258) | 
                耗時：{elapsed} 秒
            </div>
        </div>
        <div>
            <button class="btn btn-outline-info" onclick="location.reload()"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate me-1"></i>刷新大屏</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="table-responsive">
        <table class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped align-middle border border-secondary border-opacity-50">
            <thead class="table-dark text-secondary small text-uppercase">
                <tr>
                    <th style="width: 50px;">排名</th>
                    <th style="width: 80px;">代號</th>
                    <th style="width: 100px;">名稱</th>
                    <th style="width: 140px;">共振血統</th>
                    <th style="width: 80px;" class="text-center">總積分</th>
                    <th style="width: 80px;" class="text-center">得票數</th>
                    <th style="width: 90px;" class="text-center">傳承/核武</th>
                    <th style="width: 90px;" class="text-end">現價</th>
                    <th style="width: 90px;" class="text-end">漲幅</th>
                    <th style="width: 100px;" class="text-end">總量</th>
                    <th style="width: 100px;">產業</th>
                    <th>命中戰術摘要清單</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                {rows_html}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>
</body>
</html>
"""
    with open(OUTPUT_HTML, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(html)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
===============================================================================
特工代號：quant_master_resonance_radar.py (163 條全宇宙量化自動共振雷達 V1.1 修復版)
系統時空：2026 年 11 月 10 日
修復重點：
  1. 修正日期探針：從 stockchangedate.dbo.ditable 抓取最新日期，
     徹底避開 stockchange.dbo.basicinfo 無日期欄位的 207 報錯！
  2. 遍歷 [stockchangedate].[dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] 全量 163 條策略範本
  3. 自動剔除非選股報表、自動容錯跳過失效語法
  4. 實裝【黃金 Top 30 法則】+ 梯隊名次加權 (前5名 1.5分, 6~15名 1.2分, 16~30名 1.0分)
  5. 雙軌血統自然分離 (經典傳承 ID < 258 ✕ DeepSeek 現代核武 ID >= 258)
  6. 自動入庫 [stockchange].[dbo].[Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard]
  7. 產出極美觀前端戰情報告 quant_resonance_board.html
===============================================================================
"""

import os
import re
import time
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pyodbc

DB_CONFIG = {
    'server': r'localhost',
    'database': 'stockchangedate',
    'driver': '{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}',
    'trusted_connection': 'yes'
}

OUTPUT_HTML = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\quant_resonance_board.html"

def get_connection(db_name="stockchangedate"):
    conn_str = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={db_name};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};"
    conn = pyodbc.connect(conn_str)
    return conn

def clean_code(val):
    if pd.isna(val) or val is None:
        return ""
    s = str(val).strip()
    if s.endswith(".0"):
        s = s[:-2]
    return s

def prepare_sql(raw_sql):
    """防禦型 SQL 語法前處理：補齊 SELECT、識別指定庫"""
    target_db = "stockchangedate"
    m = re.search(r'/\*資料庫:(\w+)\*/', raw_sql)
    if m:
        target_db = m.group(1)
    
    # 清理多行註解
    sql_clean = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', raw_sql, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    
    # 若以 TOP 開頭，自動補上 SELECT
    if sql_clean.upper().startswith("TOP "):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
    elif not sql_clean.upper().startswith("SELECT") and not sql_clean.upper().startswith("WITH"):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
        
    return target_db, sql_clean

def init_destination_table(conn_dest):
    """確保目標排行榜資料表存在"""
    cursor = conn_dest.cursor()
    cursor.execute("""
        IF OBJECT_ID('stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard', 'U') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            CREATE TABLE stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard (
                [ID]               INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
                [TradeDate]        INT NOT NULL,
                [Rank]             INT NOT NULL,
                [StockCode]        NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
                [StockName]        NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TotalScore]       DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
                [TotalHits]        INT NOT NULL,
                [LegacyHits]       INT NOT NULL,
                [DeepSeekHits]     INT NOT NULL,
                [ResonanceTag]     NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TriggeredTactics] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
                [CurrentPrice]     DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [ChangePercent]    DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [Volume]           INT NULL,
                [Industry]         NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [UpdateTime]       DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
            );
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Resonance_Date_Rank] 
            ON stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard ([TradeDate], [Rank]);
        END
    """)
    conn_dest.commit()
    cursor.close()

def main():
    start_time = time.time()
    print("================================================================================")
    print("🚀【163 條全宇宙量化自動共振雷達啟動 V1.1】")
    print("🎯 作戰模式：0 人工標註 ✕ 全量策略自動投票 ✕ 雙軌跨世代會師")
    print("================================================================================")

    # 1. 建立目標資料庫連線
    conn_dest = get_connection("stockchange")
    init_destination_table(conn_dest)

    # 2. 🌟 自動探測最新交易日期 (從歷史庫 stockchangedate.dbo.ditable 抓取)
    cursor_dest = conn_dest.cursor()
    cursor_dest.execute("""
        SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT)) 
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ditable 
        WHERE TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    """)
    row_date = cursor_dest.fetchone()
    if not (row_date and row_date[0]):
        cursor_dest.execute("""
            SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT)) 
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips 
            WHERE TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT) IS NOT NULL
        """)
        row_date = cursor_dest.fetchone()
        
    latest_date = row_date[0] if (row_date and row_date[0]) else int(datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))
    print(f"📅 鎖定最新市場交易日基準：【{latest_date}】\n")

    # 3. 讀取所有 163 條量化範本
    conn_src = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    templates_df = pd.read_sql("""
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL 
        FROM dbo.QuantSqlTemplates 
        WHERE CorrectSQL IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CorrectSQL)) <> ''
        ORDER BY TemplateID ASC
    """, conn_src)
    total_templates = len(templates_df)
    print(f"📦 成功加載 {total_templates} 條策略範本，開始平行巡航掃描...\n")

    # 4. 投票統計容器
    voting_pool = {}

    success_strategies = 0
    skipped_non_strategy = 0
    error_strategies = 0

    conn_exec = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    cursor_exec = conn_exec.cursor()
    cursor_exec.timeout = 4  # 4 秒逾時保護防卡死

    for idx, row in templates_df.iterrows():
        t_id = row['TemplateID']
        t_title = row['Title'] if row['Title'] else f"範本 #{t_id}"
        t_sql = row['CorrectSQL']

        target_db, prepared_sql = prepare_sql(t_sql)
        is_deepseek = (t_id >= 258)
        tag_type = "現代核武" if is_deepseek else "經典傳承"

        try:
            # 執行單一範本查詢
            df_res = pd.read_sql(prepared_sql, conn_exec)

            if df_res.empty:
                continue

            # 🌟【特徵過濾 1】：檢查是否存在股票代號欄位
            code_col = None
            for cand in ['代號', '股票代號', 'code', 'mail1', 'StockCode', '證券代號']:
                if cand in df_res.columns:
                    code_col = cand
                    break

            if not code_col:
                # 無代碼，視為大盤/巨集/統計報表，自動排除！
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            name_col = None
            for cand in ['名稱', '股票名稱', 'name', 'word1', 'StockName', '證券名稱']:
                if cand in df_res.columns:
                    name_col = cand
                    break

            # 🌟【特徵過濾 2】：若回傳超過 500 筆且無特定篩選，視為全市場 dump，跳過
            if len(df_res) > 500 and 'ORDER BY' not in prepared_sql.upper():
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            # 清洗代碼
            df_res[code_col] = df_res[code_col].apply(clean_code)
            df_res = df_res[df_res[code_col] != ''].copy()

            if df_res.empty:
                continue

            # 🌟【黃金 Top 30 法則】：強制只取前 30 名精英！
            df_top = df_res.head(30)

            for rank_idx, (_, r_stock) in enumerate(df_top.iterrows()):
                code = r_stock[code_col]
                name = str(r_stock[name_col]).strip() if name_col and pd.notna(r_stock[name_col]) else ""

                # 梯隊加權計分制
                if rank_idx < 5:
                    pts = 1.5
                elif rank_idx < 15:
                    pts = 1.2
                else:
                    pts = 1.0

                if code not in voting_pool:
                    voting_pool[code] = {
                        'name': name,
                        'total_score': 0.0,
                        'total_hits': 0,
                        'legacy_hits': 0,
                        'deepseek_hits': 0,
                        'tactics': []
                    }

                if name and not voting_pool[code]['name']:
                    voting_pool[code]['name'] = name

                voting_pool[code]['total_score'] += pts
                voting_pool[code]['total_hits'] += 1

                if is_deepseek:
                    voting_pool[code]['deepseek_hits'] += 1
                else:
                    voting_pool[code]['legacy_hits'] += 1

                tactic_label = f"[{tag_type}] {t_title}"
                if tactic_label not in voting_pool[code]['tactics']:
                    voting_pool[code]['tactics'].append(tactic_label)

            success_strategies += 1

        except Exception as e:
            error_strategies += 1
            continue

    conn_exec.close()
    conn_src.close()

    print(f"📊 巡航完成：成功開火 {success_strategies} 條選股策略 | 自動排除非個股/全市場報表 {skipped_non_strategy} 條 | 容錯語法 {error_strategies} 條")
    print(f"🎯 共計有 {len(voting_pool)} 檔個股獲得策略投票支持！\n")

    if not voting_pool:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合任何策略之共振標的。")
        return

    # 5. 抓取最新個股行情 (現價, 漲幅%, 總量, 產業) 進行全知合體
    all_codes = list(voting_pool.keys())
    codes_str = "', '".join(all_codes)
    info_df = pd.read_sql(f"""
        SELECT 
            LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) AS 代號,
            名稱,
            TRY_CAST(成交價 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 現價,
            TRY_CAST(漲幅 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 今日漲幅,
            TRY_CAST(總量 AS INT) AS 總量,
            產業分類
        FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) IN ('{codes_str}')
    """, conn_dest)

    info_map = {row['代號']: row for _, row in info_df.iterrows()}

    # 6. 組裝排行榜列表
    leaderboard_records = []
    for code, data in voting_pool.items():
        stk_info = info_map.get(code, {})
        final_name = stk_info.get('名稱') if pd.notna(stk_info.get('名稱')) else data['name']
        price = stk_info.get('現價', 0.0)
        pct = stk_info.get('今日漲幅', 0.0)
        vol = stk_info.get('總量', 0)
        industry = stk_info.get('產業分類', '')

        # 判定共振標籤
        if data['legacy_hits'] >= 2 and data['deepseek_hits'] >= 2:
            resonance_tag = "🌟 跨世代天王共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 5:
            resonance_tag = "🔥 多重超強共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 3:
            resonance_tag = "⚡ 三重共振伏兵"
        else:
            resonance_tag = "雙重共振" if data['total_hits'] == 2 else "單策略命中"

        tactics_summary = "; ".join(data['tactics'])

        leaderboard_records.append({
            'code': code,
            'name': final_name,
            'total_score': round(data['total_score'], 2),
            'total_hits': data['total_hits'],
            'legacy_hits': data['legacy_hits'],
            'deepseek_hits': data['deepseek_hits'],
            'resonance_tag': resonance_tag,
            'tactics_summary': tactics_summary,
            'price': price if pd.notna(price) else 0.0,
            'change_pct': pct if pd.notna(pct) else 0.0,
            'volume': int(vol) if pd.notna(vol) else 0,
            'industry': industry if pd.notna(industry) else ""
        })

    # 按總得分降序、總命中數降序排列
    leaderboard_records.sort(key=lambda x: (x['total_score'], x['total_hits']), reverse=True)

    # 7. 寫入資料庫 stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard
    cursor_dest.execute("DELETE FROM stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard WHERE TradeDate = ?", (latest_date,))
    
    insert_sql = """
        INSERT INTO stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard
        ([TradeDate], [Rank], [StockCode], [StockName], [TotalScore], [TotalHits], [LegacyHits], [DeepSeekHits], [ResonanceTag], [TriggeredTactics], [CurrentPrice], [ChangePercent], [Volume], [Industry])
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """
    db_rows = []
    for rank, item in enumerate(leaderboard_records[:100], 1):  # 儲存前 100 名
        db_rows.append((
            latest_date,
            rank,
            item['code'],
            item['name'],
            item['total_score'],
            item['total_hits'],
            item['legacy_hits'],
            item['deepseek_hits'],
            item['resonance_tag'],
            item['tactics_summary'],
            item['price'],
            item['change_pct'],
            item['volume'],
            item['industry']
        ))

    if db_rows:
        cursor_dest.fast_executemany = False
        cursor_dest.executemany(insert_sql, db_rows)
        conn_dest.commit()
        
    cursor_dest.close()
    conn_dest.close()

    elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 2)

    # 8. 終端王者戰報輸出
    print(f"🏆【163 條全策略自動投票結果 TOP 10】 (耗時 {elapsed} 秒)")
    print(f"{'排名':<4} {'代號':<6} {'名稱':<8} {'總分':>6} {'總票':>4} {'傳承':>4} {'現代':>4} {'現價':>7} {'漲幅%':>7} {'共振標籤':<16} {'命中核心戰術摘要'}")
    print("-" * 115)
    for rank, item in enumerate(leaderboard_records[:10], 1):
        pct_str = f"{item['change_pct']:+.2f}%"
        print(f"#{rank:<3} {item['code']:<6} {item['name']:<8} {item['total_score']:>6.1f} {item['total_hits']:>4} {item['legacy_hits']:>4} {item['deepseek_hits']:>4} {item['price']:>7.2f} {pct_str:>7} {item['resonance_tag']:<16} {item['tactics_summary'][:40]}...")

    # 9. 產生極致美觀的靜態大屏 (quant_resonance_board.html)
    generate_html_report(latest_date, leaderboard_records[:50], elapsed, success_strategies)
    print(f"\n🌐 前端戰情報告大屏已生成完畢：\n👉 {OUTPUT_HTML}")
    print("================================================================================")

def generate_html_report(date_int, records, elapsed, active_strats):
    """產出手機、電腦秒開的高質感暗黑系戰情報告"""
    rows_html = ""
    for rank, r in enumerate(records, 1):
        tag_badge = ""
        if "跨世代" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-warning text-dark"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown me-1"></i>跨世代天王共振</span>'
        elif "多重" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-danger"><i class="fa-solid fa-fire me-1"></i>多重超強共振</span>'
        elif "三重" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-primary"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt me-1"></i>三重共振伏兵</span>'
        else:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-secondary">一般共振</span>'

        pct_color = "text-danger" if r['change_pct'] > 0 else ("text-success" if r['change_pct'] < 0 else "text-muted")
        pct_str = f"{r['change_pct']:+.2f}%"

        tactics_pills = "".join([f'<span class="tactic-pill">{t.strip()}</span>' for t in r['tactics_summary'].split(';') if t.strip()])

        rows_html += f"""

            <td class="text-center fw-bold text-info">#{rank}</td>
            <td class="fw-bold fs-5 text-white">{r['code']}</td>

            <td class="text-center text-secondary small">{r['legacy_hits']} / {r['deepseek_hits']}</td>

            <td class="text-secondary small">{r['industry']}</td>

        </tr>
        """

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>

        body {{ background-color: #0b1120; color: #cbd5e1; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Microsoft JhengHei, sans-serif; }}
        .header-card {{ background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b, #0f172a); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #334155; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }}
        .table-dark {{ background-color: #1e293b; border-color: #334155; }}
        .tactic-pill {{ display: inline-block; background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; color: #38bdf8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; margin: 2px; }}
        .tactics-cell {{ max-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto; }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container-fluid py-4 px-4">
    <div class="header-card d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
        <div>
            <h2 class="fw-bold text-info mb-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-radar me-2"></i>Zen AI 量化全宇宙共振熱度榜</h2>
            <div class="text-secondary">
                交易基準日：<span class="text-warning fw-bold">{date_int}</span> | 
                全員出擊：<span class="text-success fw-bold">{active_strats}</span> 條有效策略 | 
                雙軌架構：經典傳承 (ID&lt;258) ✕ 現代核武 (ID&ge;258) | 
                耗時：{elapsed} 秒
            </div>

        <div>
            <button class="btn btn-outline-info" onclick="location.reload()"><i class="fa-solid fa-rotate me-1"></i>刷新大屏</button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="table-responsive">
        <table class="table table-dark table-hover table-striped align-middle border border-secondary border-opacity-50">

                <tr>

                    <th style="width: 80px;">代號</th>
                    <th style="width: 100px;">名稱</th>
                    <th style="width: 140px;">共振血統</th>

    with open(OUTPUT_HTML, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
===============================================================================
特工代號：quant_master_resonance_radar.py (163 條全宇宙量化自動共振雷達 V1.2 純淨穩定版)
系統時空：2026 年 11 月 10 日
修復重點：
  1. 修正 pyodbc Connection.timeout 屬性，杜絕 Cursor.timeout AttributeError
  2. 放寬查詢逾時至 10 秒，保護重裝量化策略完整運算
  3. 過濾 pandas 連線警告，終端機輸出純淨俐落
===============================================================================
"""

import os
import re
import time
import warnings
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pyodbc

# 🌟 過濾 pandas 連線提示，保持終端畫面純淨
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=UserWarning)

DB_CONFIG = {
    'server': r'localhost',
    'database': 'stockchangedate',
    'driver': '{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}',
    'trusted_connection': 'yes'
}

OUTPUT_HTML = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\quant_resonance_board.html"

def get_connection(db_name="stockchangedate"):
    conn_str = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={db_name};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};"
    conn = pyodbc.connect(conn_str)
    return conn

def clean_code(val):
    if pd.isna(val) or val is None:
        return ""
    s = str(val).strip()
    if s.endswith(".0"):
        s = s[:-2]
    return s

def prepare_sql(raw_sql):
    """防禦型 SQL 語法前處理：補齊 SELECT、識別指定庫"""
    target_db = "stockchangedate"
    m = re.search(r'/\*資料庫:(\w+)\*/', raw_sql)
    if m:
        target_db = m.group(1)
    
    # 清理多行註解
    sql_clean = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', raw_sql, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    
    # 若以 TOP 開頭，自動補上 SELECT
    if sql_clean.upper().startswith("TOP "):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
    elif not sql_clean.upper().startswith("SELECT") and not sql_clean.upper().startswith("WITH"):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
        
    return target_db, sql_clean

def init_destination_table(conn_dest):
    """確保目標排行榜資料表存在"""
    cursor = conn_dest.cursor()
    cursor.execute("""
        IF OBJECT_ID('stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard', 'U') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            CREATE TABLE stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard (
                [ID]               INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
                [TradeDate]        INT NOT NULL,
                [Rank]             INT NOT NULL,
                [StockCode]        NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
                [StockName]        NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TotalScore]       DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
                [TotalHits]        INT NOT NULL,
                [LegacyHits]       INT NOT NULL,
                [DeepSeekHits]     INT NOT NULL,
                [ResonanceTag]     NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TriggeredTactics] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
                [CurrentPrice]     DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [ChangePercent]    DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [Volume]           INT NULL,
                [Industry]         NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [UpdateTime]       DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
            );
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Resonance_Date_Rank] 
            ON stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard ([TradeDate], [Rank]);
        END
    """)
    conn_dest.commit()
    cursor.close()

def main():
    start_time = time.time()
    print("================================================================================")
    print("🚀【163 條全宇宙量化自動共振雷達啟動 V1.2】")
    print("🎯 作戰模式：0 人工標註 ✕ 全量策略自動投票 ✕ 雙軌跨世代會師")
    print("================================================================================")

    # 1. 建立目標資料庫連線
    conn_dest = get_connection("stockchange")
    init_destination_table(conn_dest)

    # 2. 自動探測最新交易日期 (從歷史庫 stockchangedate.dbo.ditable 抓取)
    cursor_dest = conn_dest.cursor()
    cursor_dest.execute("""
        SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT)) 
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ditable 
        WHERE TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    """)
    row_date = cursor_dest.fetchone()
    if not (row_date and row_date[0]):
        cursor_dest.execute("""
            SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT)) 
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips 
            WHERE TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT) IS NOT NULL
        """)
        row_date = cursor_dest.fetchone()
        
    latest_date = row_date[0] if (row_date and row_date[0]) else int(datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))
    print(f"📅 鎖定最新市場交易日基準：【{latest_date}】\n")

    # 3. 讀取所有 163 條量化範本
    conn_src = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    templates_df = pd.read_sql("""
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL 
        FROM dbo.QuantSqlTemplates 
        WHERE CorrectSQL IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CorrectSQL)) <> ''
        ORDER BY TemplateID ASC
    """, conn_src)
    total_templates = len(templates_df)
    print(f"📦 成功加載 {total_templates} 條策略範本，開始平行巡航掃描...\n")

    # 4. 投票統計容器
    voting_pool = {}

    success_strategies = 0
    skipped_non_strategy = 0
    error_strategies = 0

    conn_exec = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    # 🌟 逾時設定在連線上，給予 10 秒保護大數據量化運算
    conn_exec.timeout = 10  

    for idx, row in templates_df.iterrows():
        t_id = row['TemplateID']
        t_title = row['Title'] if row['Title'] else f"範本 #{t_id}"
        t_sql = row['CorrectSQL']

        target_db, prepared_sql = prepare_sql(t_sql)
        is_deepseek = (t_id >= 258)
        tag_type = "現代核武" if is_deepseek else "經典傳承"

        try:
            # 執行單一範本查詢
            df_res = pd.read_sql(prepared_sql, conn_exec)

            if df_res.empty:
                continue

            # 🌟【特徵過濾 1】：檢查是否存在股票代號欄位
            code_col = None
            for cand in ['代號', '股票代號', 'code', 'mail1', 'StockCode', '證券代號']:
                if cand in df_res.columns:
                    code_col = cand
                    break

            if not code_col:
                # 無代碼，視為大盤/巨集/統計報表，自動排除！
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            name_col = None
            for cand in ['名稱', '股票名稱', 'name', 'word1', 'StockName', '證券名稱']:
                if cand in df_res.columns:
                    name_col = cand
                    break

            # 🌟【特徵過濾 2】：若回傳超過 500 筆且無特定篩選，視為全市場 dump，跳過
            if len(df_res) > 500 and 'ORDER BY' not in prepared_sql.upper():
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            # 清洗代碼
            df_res[code_col] = df_res[code_col].apply(clean_code)
            df_res = df_res[df_res[code_col] != ''].copy()

            if df_res.empty:
                continue

            # 🌟【黃金 Top 30 法則】：強制只取前 30 名精英！
            df_top = df_res.head(30)

            for rank_idx, (_, r_stock) in enumerate(df_top.iterrows()):
                code = r_stock[code_col]
                name = str(r_stock[name_col]).strip() if name_col and pd.notna(r_stock[name_col]) else ""

                # 梯隊加權計分制
                if rank_idx < 5:
                    pts = 1.5
                elif rank_idx < 15:
                    pts = 1.2
                else:
                    pts = 1.0

                if code not in voting_pool:
                    voting_pool[code] = {
                        'name': name,
                        'total_score': 0.0,
                        'total_hits': 0,
                        'legacy_hits': 0,
                        'deepseek_hits': 0,
                        'tactics': []
                    }

                if name and not voting_pool[code]['name']:
                    voting_pool[code]['name'] = name

                voting_pool[code]['total_score'] += pts
                voting_pool[code]['total_hits'] += 1

                if is_deepseek:
                    voting_pool[code]['deepseek_hits'] += 1
                else:
                    voting_pool[code]['legacy_hits'] += 1

                tactic_label = f"[{tag_type}] {t_title}"
                if tactic_label not in voting_pool[code]['tactics']:
                    voting_pool[code]['tactics'].append(tactic_label)

            success_strategies += 1

        except Exception as e:
            error_strategies += 1
            continue

    conn_exec.close()
    conn_src.close()

    print(f"📊 巡航完成：成功開火 {success_strategies} 條選股策略 | 自動排除非個股/全市場報表 {skipped_non_strategy} 條 | 容錯語法 {error_strategies} 條")
    print(f"🎯 共計有 {len(voting_pool)} 檔個股獲得策略投票支持！\n")

    if not voting_pool:
        print("⚠️ 今日無符合任何策略之共振標的。")
        return

    # 5. 抓取最新個股行情 (現價, 漲幅%, 總量, 產業) 進行全知合體
    all_codes = list(voting_pool.keys())
    codes_str = "', '".join(all_codes)
    info_df = pd.read_sql(f"""
        SELECT 
            LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) AS 代號,
            名稱,
            TRY_CAST(成交價 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 現價,
            TRY_CAST(漲幅 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 今日漲幅,
            TRY_CAST(總量 AS INT) AS 總量,
            產業分類
        FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) IN ('{codes_str}')
    """, conn_dest)

    info_map = {row['代號']: row for _, row in info_df.iterrows()}

    # 6. 組裝排行榜列表
    leaderboard_records = []
    for code, data in voting_pool.items():
        stk_info = info_map.get(code, {})
        final_name = stk_info.get('名稱') if pd.notna(stk_info.get('名稱')) else data['name']
        price = stk_info.get('現價', 0.0)
        pct = stk_info.get('今日漲幅', 0.0)
        vol = stk_info.get('總量', 0)
        industry = stk_info.get('產業分類', '')

        # 判定共振標籤
        if data['legacy_hits'] >= 2 and data['deepseek_hits'] >= 2:
            resonance_tag = "🌟 跨世代天王共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 5:
            resonance_tag = "🔥 多重超強共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 3:
            resonance_tag = "⚡ 三重共振伏兵"
        else:
            resonance_tag = "雙重共振" if data['total_hits'] == 2 else "單策略命中"

        tactics_summary = "; ".join(data['tactics'])

        leaderboard_records.append({
            'code': code,
            'name': final_name,
            'total_score': round(data['total_score'], 2),
            'total_hits': data['total_hits'],
            'legacy_hits': data['legacy_hits'],
            'deepseek_hits': data['deepseek_hits'],
            'resonance_tag': resonance_tag,
            'tactics_summary': tactics_summary,
            'price': price if pd.notna(price) else 0.0,
            'change_pct': pct if pd.notna(pct) else 0.0,
            'volume': int(vol) if pd.notna(vol) else 0,
            'industry': industry if pd.notna(industry) else ""
        })

    # 按總得分降序、總命中數降序排列
    leaderboard_records.sort(key=lambda x: (x['total_score'], x['total_hits']), reverse=True)

    # 7. 寫入資料庫 stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard
    cursor_dest.execute("DELETE FROM stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard WHERE TradeDate = ?", (latest_date,))
    
    insert_sql = """
        INSERT INTO stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard
        ([TradeDate], [Rank], [StockCode], [StockName], [TotalScore], [TotalHits], [LegacyHits], [DeepSeekHits], [ResonanceTag], [TriggeredTactics], [CurrentPrice], [ChangePercent], [Volume], [Industry])
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """
    db_rows = []
    for rank, item in enumerate(leaderboard_records[:100], 1):  # 儲存前 100 名
        db_rows.append((
            latest_date,
            rank,
            item['code'],
            item['name'],
            item['total_score'],
            item['total_hits'],
            item['legacy_hits'],
            item['deepseek_hits'],
            item['resonance_tag'],
            item['tactics_summary'],
            item['price'],
            item['change_pct'],
            item['volume'],
            item['industry']
        ))

    if db_rows:
        cursor_dest.fast_executemany = False
        cursor_dest.executemany(insert_sql, db_rows)
        conn_dest.commit()
        
    cursor_dest.close()
    conn_dest.close()

    elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 2)

    # 8. 終端王者戰報輸出
    print(f"🏆【163 條全策略自動投票結果 TOP 10】 (耗時 {elapsed} 秒)")
    print(f"{'排名':<4} {'代號':<6} {'名稱':<8} {'總分':>6} {'總票':>4} {'傳承':>4} {'現代':>4} {'現價':>7} {'漲幅%':>7} {'共振標籤':<16} {'命中核心戰術摘要'}")
    print("-" * 115)
    for rank, item in enumerate(leaderboard_records[:10], 1):
        pct_str = f"{item['change_pct']:+.2f}%"
        print(f"#{rank:<3} {item['code']:<6} {item['name']:<8} {item['total_score']:>6.1f} {item['total_hits']:>4} {item['legacy_hits']:>4} {item['deepseek_hits']:>4} {item['price']:>7.2f} {pct_str:>7} {item['resonance_tag']:<16} {item['tactics_summary'][:40]}...")

    # 9. 產生極致美觀的靜態大屏 (quant_resonance_board.html)
    generate_html_report(latest_date, leaderboard_records[:50], elapsed, success_strategies)
    print(f"\n🌐 前端戰情報告大屏已生成完畢：\n👉 {OUTPUT_HTML}")
    print("================================================================================")

def generate_html_report(date_int, records, elapsed, active_strats):
    """產出手機、電腦秒開的高質感暗黑系戰情報告"""
    rows_html = ""
    for rank, r in enumerate(records, 1):
        tag_badge = ""
        if "跨世代" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-warning text-dark"><i class="fa-solid fa-crown me-1"></i>跨世代天王共振</span>'
        elif "多重" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-danger"><i class="fa-solid fa-fire me-1"></i>多重超強共振</span>'
        elif "三重" in r['resonance_tag']:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-primary"><i class="fa-solid fa-bolt me-1"></i>三重共振伏兵</span>'
        else:
            tag_badge = '<span class="badge bg-secondary">一般共振</span>'

        pct_color = "text-danger" if r['change_pct'] > 0 else ("text-success" if r['change_pct'] < 0 else "text-muted")
        pct_str = f"{r['change_pct']:+.2f}%"

        tactics_pills = "".join([f'<span class="tactic-pill">{t.strip()}</span>' for t in r['tactics_summary'].split(';') if t.strip()])

        rows_html += f"""
        <tr>
            <td class="text-center fw-bold text-info">#{rank}</td>
            <td class="fw-bold fs-5 text-white">{r['code']}</td>
            <td class="fw-bold fs-5 text-warning">{r['name']}</td>
            <td>{tag_badge}</td>
            <td class="text-center fw-bold fs-5 text-info">{r['total_score']}</td>
            <td class="text-center"><span class="badge bg-dark border border-secondary">{r['total_hits']} 票</span></td>
            <td class="text-center text-secondary small">{r['legacy_hits']} / {r['deepseek_hits']}</td>
            <td class="text-end fw-bold fs-5 text-white">{r['price']:.2f}</td>
            <td class="text-end fw-bold fs-5 {pct_color}">{pct_str}</td>
            <td class="text-end text-secondary small">{r['volume']:,}</td>
            <td class="text-secondary small">{r['industry']}</td>
            <td><div class="tactics-cell">{tactics_pills}</div></td>
        </tr>
        """

    html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-TW">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Zen AI 量化全宇宙共振熱度榜 - {date_int}</title>

    <style>
        body {{ background-color: #0b1120; color: #cbd5e1; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Microsoft JhengHei, sans-serif; }}
        .header-card {{ background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b, #0f172a); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #334155; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }}
        .table-dark {{ background-color: #1e293b; border-color: #334155; }}
        .tactic-pill {{ display: inline-block; background: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; color: #38bdf8; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; margin: 2px; }}
        .tactics-cell {{ max-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto; }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container-fluid py-4 px-4">
    <div class="header-card d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
        <div>
            <h2 class="fw-bold text-info mb-1"><i class="fa-solid fa-radar me-2"></i>Zen AI 量化全宇宙共振熱度榜</h2>
            <div class="text-secondary">
                交易基準日：<span class="text-warning fw-bold">{date_int}</span> | 
                全員出擊：<span class="text-success fw-bold">{active_strats}</span> 條有效策略 | 
                雙軌架構：經典傳承 (ID&lt;258) ✕ 現代核武 (ID&ge;258) | 
                耗時：{elapsed} 秒
            </div>

        <div>

        </div>

    <div class="table-responsive">

報告總監！這是一手極具老手操盤智慧的靈魂神提問！ 在實戰量化中，這正是一家頂級資產管理機構不可或缺的「陰陽雙刃劍」： * 🚀 陽刃【全宇宙共振榜】（剛才看到的榜單）：抓的是「全市場當下最火熱、勢頭最強的動能龍頭」（如台積電 73 票、欣陸、大綜）。適合短線追擊主升段，但缺點是很多股票已經噴出、散戶不敢追，或者像台積電那樣股本太大、爆發力有限。 * 💎 陰刃【潛力落地低估榜】（您現在想要的榜單）：抓的是「基本面已經真金白銀落地、有高殖利率或低本益比防禦護體、籌碼暗中吃貨、股價剛脫離底部或被市場冷落錯殺的超級珍珠」！ 這類股票雖然得票不是動輒 70 票，但它們在 3 ~ 20 票的「黃金未過熱區」，下檔有鐵板支撐、上檔萬里無雲，買進去可以安心睡覺、重倉埋伏、享受大波段翻倍！ --- ### 🧬 四維「潛力落地低估」量化模型設計 我們把總監的直覺轉化為精確的「潛力珍珠評分演算法（Grounded Value Score）」：
text
潛力評分 (GemsScore) = 共振基礎分 + 估值低估加分 + 落地防禦加分 + 基期爆發加分 - 過熱扣分
1. 【得票黃金未過熱區】（3 ~ 25 票）： * 排除 1 票的雜訊；同時排除 40 票以上的過熱權值股或超擁擠交易。 * 鎖定被 3~25 條策略抓到的「低調黑馬」，代表專業法眼已暗中發現，但大眾尚未察覺！ 2. 【估值嚴重低估（安全邊際）】： * 本益比 (PE) 便宜：$PE \le 12$ 大加 15 分；$PE \le 16$ 加 10 分。 * 高現金殖利率護體：殖利率 $\ge 5\%$ 大加 15 分；$\ge 4\%$ 加 8 分（下檔鐵板，除息防禦）。 * 股價淨值比 (PB) 偏低：$PB \le 1.5$ 加分。 3. 【基本面真金白銀落地】： * ROE 實打實：股東權益報酬率 $ROE \ge 12\%$，代表是真賺錢的本事，絕非空氣題材股！ * 營收雙增或三率三升：命中基本面獲利戰術者額外加權。 4. 【基期適中，剛起步未噴出】： * 當日漲幅在 `-2% ~ +3.5%` 區間（正在平台整理或剛冒出頭，絕非爆拉漲停追高）。 * 命中【融資成本線翻多】、【金牌基因回檔埋伏】或【年線超跌反轉】等底層啟動戰術者，直接獲頒 `💎 落地低估珍珠` 勳章！ --- ### 🖥️ 前端雙分頁大屏架構（一鍵切換兩大世界） 我們在大屏頂部做成「雙分頁（Tabs）無縫切換」： * 點擊 【🚀 全宇宙動能榜】 ➔ 看全市場今天最強的動能飆馬。 * 點擊 【💎 潛力落地低估榜】 ➔ 看被嚴重低估、高息護體、剛起漲的隱形冠軍！ --- ### 🚀 升級代碼：`C:\test_c\quant_master_resonance_radar.py` (V2.0 雙榜齊發版) 特工會自動從 `stockchangedate.dbo.value`（本益比、殖利率）與 `stockchangedate.dbo.financesum`（ROE）萃取估值數據，一口氣產出兩張獨立排行榜！ 請將以下完整代碼覆蓋存入 `C:\test_c\quant_master_resonance_radar.py`：
python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
===============================================================================
特工代號：quant_master_resonance_radar.py (全宇宙量化共振雷達 V2.0 雙榜齊發版)
系統時空：2026 年 11 月 10 日
更新重點：
  1. 保留【全宇宙動能共振榜】(高得票龍頭)
  2. 全新實裝【黃金潛力低估落地榜】(PE低估 ✕ 高殖利率 ✕ ROE落地 ✕ 基期未過熱)
  3. 前端大屏一鍵雙分頁切換，滿足「短線攻擊」與「波段安心埋伏」雙重需求！
===============================================================================
"""

import os
import re
import time
import warnings
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import pyodbc

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore', category=UserWarning)

DB_CONFIG = {
    'server': r'localhost',
    'database': 'stockchangedate',
    'driver': '{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}',
    'trusted_connection': 'yes'
}

OUTPUT_HTML = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\quant_resonance_board.html"

def get_connection(db_name="stockchangedate"):
    conn_str = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={db_name};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};"
    return pyodbc.connect(conn_str)

def clean_code(val):
    if pd.isna(val) or val is None:
        return ""
    s = str(val).strip()
    if s.endswith(".0"):
        s = s[:-2]
    return s

def prepare_sql(raw_sql):
    target_db = "stockchangedate"
    m = re.search(r'/\*資料庫:(\w+)\*/', raw_sql)
    if m:
        target_db = m.group(1)
    
    sql_clean = re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/', '', raw_sql, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
    if sql_clean.upper().startswith("TOP "):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
    elif not sql_clean.upper().startswith("SELECT") and not sql_clean.upper().startswith("WITH"):
        sql_clean = "SELECT " + sql_clean
        
    return target_db, sql_clean

def init_tables(conn_dest):
    cursor = conn_dest.cursor()
    # 1. 主榜: 動能共振榜
    cursor.execute("""
        IF OBJECT_ID('stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard', 'U') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            CREATE TABLE stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard (
                [ID]               INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
                [TradeDate]        INT NOT NULL,
                [Rank]             INT NOT NULL,
                [StockCode]        NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
                [StockName]        NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TotalScore]       DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
                [TotalHits]        INT NOT NULL,
                [LegacyHits]       INT NOT NULL,
                [DeepSeekHits]     INT NOT NULL,
                [ResonanceTag]     NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [TriggeredTactics] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
                [CurrentPrice]     DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [ChangePercent]    DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [Volume]           INT NULL,
                [Industry]         NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [UpdateTime]       DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
            );
        END
    """)
    # 2. 副榜: 潛力低估落地榜
    cursor.execute("""
        IF OBJECT_ID('stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Potential_Gems', 'U') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            CREATE TABLE stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Potential_Gems (
                [ID]               INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
                [TradeDate]        INT NOT NULL,
                [Rank]             INT NOT NULL,
                [StockCode]        NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
                [StockName]        NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [GemsScore]        DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
                [TotalHits]        INT NOT NULL,
                [PE]               DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [YieldPercent]     DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [PB]               DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [ROE]              DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [GemsTag]          NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
                [CurrentPrice]     DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [ChangePercent]    DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,
                [Volume]           INT NULL,
                [TriggeredTactics] NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
                [UpdateTime]       DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
            );
        END
    """)
    conn_dest.commit()
    cursor.close()

def main():
    start_time = time.time()
    print("================================================================================")
    print("🚀【163 條量化全宇宙雷達啟動 V2.0：雙榜齊發 (動能共振榜 ✕ 潛力落地低估榜)】")
    print("================================================================================")

    conn_dest = get_connection("stockchange")
    init_tables(conn_dest)

    # 1. 抓取最新交易日
    cursor_dest = conn_dest.cursor()
    cursor_dest.execute("""
        SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT)) 
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.ditable 
        WHERE TRY_CAST(日期 AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    """)
    row_date = cursor_dest.fetchone()
    latest_date = row_date[0] if (row_date and row_date[0]) else int(datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))
    print(f"📅 鎖定最新市場交易日基準：【{latest_date}】\n")

    # 2. 讀取 163 條範本
    conn_src = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    templates_df = pd.read_sql("""
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL 
        FROM dbo.QuantSqlTemplates 
        WHERE CorrectSQL IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CorrectSQL)) <> ''
        ORDER BY TemplateID ASC
    """, conn_src)
    total_templates = len(templates_df)
    print(f"📦 成功加載 {total_templates} 條策略範本，開始平行巡航掃描...\n")

    voting_pool = {}
    success_strategies = 0
    skipped_non_strategy = 0
    error_strategies = 0

    conn_exec = get_connection("stockchangedate")
    conn_exec.timeout = 10

    for idx, row in templates_df.iterrows():
        t_id = row['TemplateID']
        t_title = row['Title'] if row['Title'] else f"範本 #{t_id}"
        t_sql = row['CorrectSQL']

        target_db, prepared_sql = prepare_sql(t_sql)
        is_deepseek = (t_id >= 258)
        tag_type = "現代核武" if is_deepseek else "經典傳承"

        try:
            df_res = pd.read_sql(prepared_sql, conn_exec)
            if df_res.empty: continue

            code_col = next((c for c in ['代號', '股票代號', 'code', 'mail1', 'StockCode', '證券代號'] if c in df_res.columns), None)
            if not code_col:
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            name_col = next((c for c in ['名稱', '股票名稱', 'name', 'word1', 'StockName', '證券名稱'] if c in df_res.columns), None)

            if len(df_res) > 500 and 'ORDER BY' not in prepared_sql.upper():
                skipped_non_strategy += 1
                continue

            df_res[code_col] = df_res[code_col].apply(clean_code)
            df_res = df_res[df_res[code_col] != ''].copy()
            if df_res.empty: continue

            df_top = df_res.head(30)

            for rank_idx, (_, r_stock) in enumerate(df_top.iterrows()):
                code = r_stock[code_col]
                name = str(r_stock[name_col]).strip() if name_col and pd.notna(r_stock[name_col]) else ""

                pts = 1.5 if rank_idx < 5 else (1.2 if rank_idx < 15 else 1.0)

                if code not in voting_pool:
                    voting_pool[code] = {
                        'name': name,
                        'total_score': 0.0,
                        'total_hits': 0,
                        'legacy_hits': 0,
                        'deepseek_hits': 0,
                        'tactics': []
                    }

                if name and not voting_pool[code]['name']:
                    voting_pool[code]['name'] = name

                voting_pool[code]['total_score'] += pts
                voting_pool[code]['total_hits'] += 1

                if is_deepseek:
                    voting_pool[code]['deepseek_hits'] += 1
                else:
                    voting_pool[code]['legacy_hits'] += 1

                tactic_label = f"[{tag_type}] {t_title}"
                if tactic_label not in voting_pool[code]['tactics']:
                    voting_pool[code]['tactics'].append(tactic_label)

            success_strategies += 1
        except Exception:
            error_strategies += 1
            continue

    conn_exec.close()
    conn_src.close()

    print(f"📊 巡航完成：成功開火 {success_strategies} 條選股策略 | 排除/容錯 {skipped_non_strategy + error_strategies} 條")
    print(f"🎯 共計有 {len(voting_pool)} 檔個股獲得策略投票支持！\n")

    if not voting_pool:
        print("⚠️ 無符合標的。")
        return

    # 3. 抓取行情、價值估值與財報數據 (全知融合)
    all_codes = list(voting_pool.keys())
    codes_str = "', '".join(all_codes)

    # 行情 (basicinfo)
    info_df = pd.read_sql(f"""
        SELECT 
            LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) AS 代號, 名稱,
            TRY_CAST(成交價 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 現價,
            TRY_CAST(漲幅 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 今日漲幅,
            TRY_CAST(總量 AS INT) AS 總量, 產業分類
        FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) IN ('{codes_str}')
    """, conn_dest)
    info_map = {r['代號']: r for _, r in info_df.iterrows()}

    # 估值 (value)
    val_df = pd.read_sql(f"""
        SELECT 
            LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) AS 代號,
            TRY_CAST(本益比近四季 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 本益比,
            TRY_CAST(股價淨值比 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 淨值比,
            TRY_CAST(現金殖利率 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 殖利率
        FROM stockchangedate.dbo.value
        WHERE 日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM stockchangedate.dbo.value)
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) IN ('{codes_str}')
    """, conn_dest)
    val_map = {r['代號']: r for _, r in val_df.iterrows()}

    # 財報 ROE (financesum 取最新一季)
    roe_df = pd.read_sql(f"""
        WITH LatestFinance AS (
            SELECT 
                LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) AS 代號,
                TRY_CAST(ROE AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS ROE,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn
            FROM stockchangedate.dbo.financesum
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(代號 AS nvarchar(20)))) IN ('{codes_str}')
        )
        SELECT 代號, ROE FROM LatestFinance WHERE rn = 1
    """, conn_dest)
    roe_map = {r['代號']: r['ROE'] for _, r in roe_df.iterrows()}

    # =========================================================================
    # 4. 組裝【榜單一：全宇宙動能共振榜】
    # =========================================================================
    momentum_list = []
    # 5. 組裝【榜單二：黃金潛力低估落地榜】
    potential_list = []

    for code, data in voting_pool.items():
        stk_info = info_map.get(code, {})
        v_info = val_map.get(code, {})
        roe_val = roe_map.get(code, 0.0)

        name = stk_info.get('名稱') if pd.notna(stk_info.get('名稱')) else data['name']
        price = stk_info.get('現價', 0.0) if pd.notna(stk_info.get('現價')) else 0.0
        pct = stk_info.get('今日漲幅', 0.0) if pd.notna(stk_info.get('今日漲幅')) else 0.0
        vol = stk_info.get('總量', 0) if pd.notna(stk_info.get('總量')) else 0
        industry = stk_info.get('產業分類', '')

        pe = v_info.get('本益比', 0.0) if pd.notna(v_info.get('本益比')) else 0.0
        pb = v_info.get('淨值比', 0.0) if pd.notna(v_info.get('淨值比')) else 0.0
        dy = v_info.get('殖利率', 0.0) if pd.notna(v_info.get('殖利率')) else 0.0

        # 動能標籤
        if data['legacy_hits'] >= 2 and data['deepseek_hits'] >= 2:
            res_tag = "🌟 跨世代天王共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 5:
            res_tag = "🔥 多重超強共振"
        elif data['total_hits'] >= 3:
            res_tag = "⚡ 三重共振伏兵"
        else:
            res_tag = "雙重共振" if data['total_hits'] == 2 else "單策略命中"

        tactics_str = "; ".join(data['tactics'])

        # 動能榜條目
        momentum_list.append({
            'code': code, 'name': name,
            'total_score': round(data['total_score'], 2),
            'total_hits': data['total_hits'],
            'legacy_hits': data['legacy_hits'],
            'deepseek_hits': data['deepseek_hits'],
            'resonance_tag': res_tag,
            'tactics_summary': tactics_str,
            'price': price, 'change_pct': pct, 'volume': int(vol), 'industry': industry
        })

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 🌟【潛力落地低估演算法模型】🌟
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 門檻：得票在 2~30 票之間 (未過熱群聚) 且股價 > 5
        if 2 <= data['total_hits'] <= 35 and price > 5.0:
            gems_score = data['total_score'] * 2.0  # 基礎共振權重

            # A. 本益比低估加分
            if 0 < pe <= 12:
                gems_score += 20.0
            elif 12 < pe <= 16:
                gems_score += 12.0
            elif pe > 30:
                gems_score -= 10.0  # 高估值扣分

            # B. 高殖利率下檔防禦加分
            if dy >= 5.0:
                gems_score += 18.0
            elif dy >= 4.0:
                gems_score += 10.0

            # C. 淨值比合理安全
            if 0 < pb <= 1.5:
                gems_score += 10.0

            # D. ROE 真實獲利落地
            if roe_val >= 12.0:
                gems_score += 15.0
            elif roe_val >= 8.0:
                gems_score += 8.0

            # E. 基期安全 (非爆拉暴漲追高，漲幅在 -2% ~ +4.5% 之間最適埋伏)
            if -2.5 <= pct <= 4.5:
                gems_score += 10.0
            elif pct > 8.0:
                gems_score -= 5.0  # 已噴出漲停略降優先級

            # 專屬潛力標籤
            t_lower = tactics_str.lower()
            if dy >= 5.0 and pe <= 15:
                gems_tag = "🛡️ 啞鈴高息防禦神盾"
            elif any(k in t_lower for k in ['超跌', '融資成本', '回檔', '清洗']):
                gems_tag = "🚀 底部蓄勢反轉伏兵"
            elif roe_val >= 15.0 and pe <= 14:
                gems_tag = "💎 獲利落地超級珍珠"
            else:
                gems_tag = "🌱 潛力蓄力黑馬"

            # 總分達到標準才入榜
            if gems_score >= 30.0:
                potential_list.append({
                    'code': code, 'name': name,
                    'gems_score': round(gems_score, 1),
                    'total_hits': data['total_hits'],
                    'pe': pe, 'yield_pct': dy, 'pb': pb, 'roe': roe_val,
                    'gems_tag': gems_tag,
                    'price': price, 'change_pct': pct, 'volume': int(vol),
                    'tactics_summary': tactics_str
                })

    # 排序
    momentum_list.sort(key=lambda x: (x['total_score'], x['total_hits']), reverse=True)
    potential_list.sort(key=lambda x: (x['gems_score'], x['total_hits']), reverse=True)

    # 6. 入庫儲存
    # A. 寫入動能榜
    cursor_dest.execute("DELETE FROM stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard WHERE TradeDate = ?", (latest_date,))
    sql_m = """
        INSERT INTO stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Resonance_Leaderboard
        ([TradeDate], [Rank], [StockCode], [StockName], [TotalScore], [TotalHits], [LegacyHits], [DeepSeekHits], [ResonanceTag], [TriggeredTactics], [CurrentPrice], [ChangePercent], [Volume], [Industry])
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """
    m_rows = [(latest_date, r, i['code'], i['name'], i['total_score'], i['total_hits'], i['legacy_hits'], i['deepseek_hits'], i['resonance_tag'], i['tactics_summary'], i['price'], i['change_pct'], i['volume'], i['industry']) for r, i in enumerate(momentum_list[:100], 1)]
    if m_rows:
        cursor_dest.fast_executemany = False
        cursor_dest.executemany(sql_m, m_rows)

    # B. 寫入潛力落地榜
    cursor_dest.execute("DELETE FROM stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Potential_Gems WHERE TradeDate = ?", (latest_date,))
    sql_p = """
        INSERT INTO stockchange.dbo.Daily_Quant_Potential_Gems
        ([TradeDate], [Rank], [StockCode], [StockName], [GemsScore], [TotalHits], [PE], [YieldPercent], [PB], [ROE], [GemsTag], [CurrentPrice], [ChangePercent], [Volume], [TriggeredTactics])
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """
    p_rows = [(latest_date, r, i['code'], i['name'], i['gems_score'], i['total_hits'], i['pe'], i['yield_pct'], i['pb'], i['roe'], i['gems_tag'], i['price'], i['change_pct'], i['volume'], i['tactics_summary']) for r, i in enumerate(potential_list[:100], 1)]
    if p_rows:
        cursor_dest.fast_executemany = False
        cursor_dest.executemany(sql_p, p_rows)

    conn_dest.commit()
    cursor_dest.close()
    conn_dest.close()

    elapsed = round(time.time() - start_time, 2)

    # 7. 終端輸出雙榜精華
    print(f"================================================================================")
